svg.title: Figure 03 · Feasible portfolios and the efficient boundary
svg.desc: Three-asset annual simple-return benchmark; expected returns 6%, 10%, 14%, volatilities 10%, 18%, 28%, correlations AB = .20, AC = .10, BC = .35. Cloud: 1,800 Dirichlet draws, seed 3001. Frontier: constrained optimisation, not the outer edge of the random cloud.
